facts_from_exact_source: Current AccountLease.run has no caller opt-out and failover-eligible exceptions proceed to _switch_account().
Current handle_openai_responses enters its recursive foreground transport retry only from except AccountPoolExhausted.
Current initial/continuation step passes retry_operation=initial_completion to AccountLease.run.
Current planner correction is a deliberate second provider step on the same lease and also currently passes retry_operation=initial_completion.

conclusion.outer_retry: If every deliberate provider step after strict intent publication calls AccountLease.run(..., allow_failover=false), ambiguous transport propagates directly instead of becoming AccountPoolExhausted; therefore the current AccountPoolExhausted-only recursive foreground retry is unreachable for that protected path. A separate server retry-disable flag is not required for this exact path, but the invariant must be regression-tested in the combined Stage-B candidate.
conclusion.planner_correction: Planner correction remains valid as an explicit bounded second/third planner step on the same lease/account. Each deliberate step must use allow_failover=false and may execute at most once.
conclusion.agent_rotation: Default allow_failover=true preserves existing Agent failover behavior; Core must not change that default.
conclusion.raw_httpx_evidence_gap: Raw httpx.HTTPError is failover-eligible and V41 opt-out prevents switching, but current transport evidence recording is specialized to NotionAgentError(ErrorCode.TRANSPORT). This is an observability gap, not a duplicate-provider safety gap; do not broaden Agent behavior merely to close it before Stage-B safety is complete.

why_windows_not_ready: Stage-B exact server orchestration is not yet integrated locally; Windows semantics are not yet the only remaining unknown.
